reuseNotes: 憧れる、ためらう、羨ましい、励ます、慰める、恨む and other already taught roots reused, not duplicated.
恨み is linked conceptually to existing恨む without a new synonym card or claimed automatic mastery.
頼む→頼み、笑う→笑い、遊ぶ→遊び、争う→争い reuse event nominal stems in these explicit contexts; no universal verb-to-person-noun rule inferred. 知り合い as a person remains distinct from the existing verb知り合う.
Vstem＋方、Vstem＋直す、adjective＋さ andする reuse already taught forms; no productive combinations counted as new roots.
Corrected草を抜く to physical transitive抜く(vn4868), not intransitive抜ける(vn4869).
